name: VetAgentBench-IN
description: VetAgentBench-IN: does giving an LLM retrieval, tools, self-verification and safety guardrails make its veterinary advice safer? 29 India-focused livestock & companion-animal cases, 5 agent conditions (C0–C4), dangerous-error metrics with Wilson CIs and McNemar tests, India's SVTG as knowledge source. Research prototype, not for clinical use.
